description: A project's versions, in their sequence. A version is what a project's work goes out in — '2.4.0', 'Autumn'. It is the project's own: an issue carries versions of its own project only, any number of them ('fixVersions' on create_issue, update_issue and get_issue; JQL 'fixVersion = "2.4.0"', 'fixVersion in unreleasedVersions()'). Each with its id, name, description, startDate and releaseDate (YYYY-MM-DD), whether it is released or archived (put away: still on its issues, no longer offered), 'overdue' (its day has passed and it has not shipped), and how many issues it carries — 'issues' — and how many of those are not finished — 'open'. Also 'canEdit': whether you may make, change and release versions here. Any member may read them.

hideArchived.description: Leave out the versions that are archived. They are listed by default, since an issue may still carry one.

name: list_versions
